convention.handicap_home: points added to the home team; -3.0 means home favoured by 3

why_sigma_matters: the market-implied handicap is a translation of a probability through OUR normal model, so it is not a number the market publishes. The published handicap is the market's own number and sits beside it. When the two disagree, the model's sigma is wrong, not the market.

blend.decision_rule: Do not adopt a non-zero weight until all four hold: (1) at least 60 priced games scored; (2) the weight is re-fitted walk-forward, i.e. fitted only on weeks before the week it scores; (3) the blended model's lower 95% bootstrap bound on per-bet skill is above 0; (4) that survives Holm across the whole strategy family. A weight fitted on 15 games is a description of 15 games.
